reserveReview.reviewer: SOL-III Safety Score V9 reserve review
reserveReview.rationale: At finalized Ethereum block 25538539, two independent RPCs returned canonical Lido wstETH from the USDN protocol proxy getAsset() call. The same block reconciled the proxy and stored vault balances with the pinned SmarDex deployment source and the current live reserve producer. The sole 100% reserve exposure is therefore classified as perpetual wstETH crypto collateral; liquidity remains unknown because protocol imbalance protections can suspend withdrawals and Lido withdrawal queues have no defensible fixed upper bound.

reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: No unidentified reserve slice remains; market, liquidity, smart-contract, basis, and concentration risks remain structured on the wstETH exposure.
